cities_neighbourhood_namespace.name: cities_neighbourhood_namespace
cities_neighbourhood_namespace.value: "cities"."district_id" IS NULL OR ("cities"."source_code" IS NOT NULL AND "cities"."source_code" ~ '^(OSM:(node|way|relation)/[0-9]+|WD:Q[0-9]+|PUPZY:[a-z0-9-]+)$')

announcements_text_not_blank.name: announcements_text_not_blank
announcements_text_not_blank.value: btrim("announcements"."title_en") <> '' AND btrim("announcements"."body_en") <> '' AND btrim("announcements"."title_ar") <> '' AND btrim("announcements"."body_ar") <> ''
